description: This file implements Android Debug Bridge (ADB) backend functionality, including device management, command execution, socket communication, and connection handling for Android devices within the Playwright testing framework.

classes.name: AdbDevice
classes.description: Represents an Android device connected via ADB, providing methods to initialize, close, run commands, and open socket connections.

classes.name: BufferedSocketWrapper
classes.description: Wraps a net.Socket to provide buffered read/write operations, socket mode switching, and event handling for ADB communication.

methods.name: runCommand
methods.description: Executes an ADB command over a socket connection, handling protocol specifics and response parsing.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Opens a socket connection to an Android device for a specific command, establishing the transport.

methods.name: encodeMessage
methods.description: Encodes a string message into a Buffer with a length prefix for ADB protocol communication.
